description: Use when you need speech to text transcription or translation of an audio file at a public URL. Do not use for audio over 10 MB or speaker labels. Returns JSON with a Whisper transcription of an audio file: text, timed segments and language, or an English translation for 0.005 USDC per megabyte, up to 0.05 USDC per call (clients without upto pay the cap). Result in the same call (about 20000 ms); a status tool polls for free if it takes longer. Category: Media. Price: US$0.05 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the spoken language, e.g. en or pt (detected when omitted)

task.description: transcribe keeps the spoken language; translate returns English (transcribe when omitted)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the audio file, e.g. https://example.com/talk.mp3 (mp3, wav, ogg, m4a, webm; up to 10 MB)

name: blackwood_audio_transcribe
title: Speech to text
